name: k8s-anything
description: Agentic base that transforms any app into a Kubernetes deployment, on top of existing tools.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any app into a Kubernetes deployment
interface.longDescription: Orchestrates docker init, buildpacks, kompose, kubeconform, kube-linter and kind, with agents that ground every decision in the app's code and harden the output for production.
defaultPrompt: Use k8s-anything to deploy this app to Kubernetes with dev and prod overlays.
Use k8s-anything to convert this docker-compose setup to Kubernetes.
Use k8s-anything to harden the Kubernetes manifests in deploy/.
